description: This Java class 'StartupCommand' represents a command-line argument passed to the OFBiz framework after processing. It encapsulates the command name and associated properties, providing a builder pattern for creating instances.

classes.name: StartupCommand
classes.description: A class representing a processed command line argument for OFBiz, encapsulating the command name and associated properties.

classes.name: StartupCommand.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of StartupCommand with optional properties.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the properties associated with the command.

methods.name: Builder(String)
methods.description: Constructor for the Builder class that initializes the required command name.

methods.name: properties(Map<String, String>)
methods.description: Sets the properties map for the command in the builder.

methods.name: addProperty(String, String)
methods.description: Adds a single property key-value pair to the command in the builder.

methods.name: build()
methods.description: Constructs and returns a StartupCommand instance from the builder.
